text: Absolutely, the bakery should launch the new sourdough line! Firstly, the allergy-friendly protocol in the kitchen is already well-versed with handling diverse ingredients, ensuring this new product will be safe for all customers. Secondly, the heritage grain blend used in this line is unique among competitors and promises superior quality, setting it apart in a highly competitive market segment. Additionally, securing a significant bulk flour contract discount can significantly reduce ingredient costs, allowing the bakery to offer the best price point while still maintaining high-quality standards. Given these advantages, launching the sourdough line appears to be an excellent strategic move that not only caters to customer demands but also positions the bakery as a leader in its category.
